    54→func (vs *Server) GetBeaconBlock(ctx context.Context, req *ethpb.BlockRequest) (*ethpb.GenericBeaconBlock, error) {

    73→	if slots.ToEpoch(req.Slot) >= params.BeaconConfig().BellatrixForkEpoch {
    74→		if err := vs.optimisticStatus(ctx); err != nil {

    76→			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unavailable, "Validator is not ready to propose: %v", err)
    77→		}
    78→	}

    81→	if err != nil {

    83→		return nil, err
    84→	}

    88→		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "Could not prepare block: %v", err)
    89→	}

    91→	sBlk.SetSlot(req.Slot)
    92→	sBlk.SetGraffiti(req.Graffiti)

    94→	sBlk.SetParentRoot(parentRoot[:])
